tools.name: database_overview
tools.description: Overview of the Data Candy US business-lead database: how many records it holds, how many have an email, a mobile number or a website, how fresh the data is, the fields on each lead, and the current prices and payment options. Free, no account needed.

tools.name: list_industries
tools.description: List the industries you can filter on, with lead counts. Pass `search` (for example "roof") to also find the more specific categories such as "Roofing contractor". Use the exact names it returns in the industry and category filters. Free.

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: List US states with lead counts, or the cities of one state (pass `state`, optionally `search` to narrow by name). Use the exact values in the state and city filters. Free.

tools.name: count_leads
tools.description: Count the leads that match the filters (industry, category, keyword, state, city, ZIP, has_email, has_cell and so on). Fast and free; nothing is charged. Returns the count and whether it is exact.

tools.name: preview_leads
tools.description: Show up to 10 sample leads for the filters with email, phone and last name partly hidden, plus the total number of matches. Free; use it to check the filters return the kind of businesses you want.

tools.name: quote_leads
tools.description: Exact price for buying `quantity` leads for the filters. Nothing is charged. Returns how many leads match, the price in dollars and the payment methods available right now.

tools.name: buy_leads
tools.description: Buy leads. THIS SPENDS MONEY AND CANNOT BE UNDONE. max_price_usd is required: nothing is bought if the price is higher. Paid from the account's credits (API key needed) it returns the leads at once: the first 25 inline and download links for the full set. Otherwise it returns a checkout link and an

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Check an order by its id: status (awaiting_payment, paid, fulfilled, expired ...), price and, once fulfilled, the first 25 leads plus download links for the whole set. Use it after a person has paid a checkout link. Nothing is charged.

tools.name: account_status
tools.description: Show the account behind your API key: email, plan, credit balance, today's usage and spend limits. Needs an API key (Authorization: Bearer dc_live_... or X-API-Key).

tools.name: add_credits
tools.description: Start a credit top-up of $10 to $1,000. THIS SPENDS MONEY once a person pays. Returns a Stripe checkout link that a person must open; the credits arrive after payment and buy_leads then spends them. Needs an API key.

tools.name: create_account
tools.description: Create a Data Candy account and API key for an email address (free; credits start at $0). The key is shown once: store it. Returns the exact MCP configuration to reconnect with the key. If the email already has an account, no key is returned and its owner gets a sign-in link by email.

tools.name: get_free_sample
tools.description: Email 25 free real sample leads to an address (use the person's own email). This sends a real email. No text message is sent from here.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "account_status" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: preview_leads, get_free_sample · Private data: database_overview, buy_leads, account_status, add_credits, create_account · Public sink: database_overview, preview_leads, account_status, create_account, get_free_sample · Destructive: buy_leads.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: preview_leads, get_free_sample · Private data: database_overview, buy_leads, account_status, add_credits, create_account · Public sink: database_overview, preview_leads, account_status, create_account, get_free_sample · Destructive: buy_leads

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
